findings.location: tools/generate_intrinsic_operation_classification_fixtures.py:347-370; the logical_and, logical_or and logical_eqv fixture sources; catalogue claim at intrinsic_operation_classification_10_1_5_1.json:590
findings.issue: THE LOGICAL TRUTH TABLES WERE VACUOUS. .AND. asserted only (T,T)->T and (T,F)->F, which .EQV. satisfies identically on those rows. .EQV. was likewise indistinguishable from .AND. .OR. asserted only (F,F)->F and (F,T)->T, which .NEQV. satisfies identically.
findings.how_it_was_proved: ADVERSARIALLY, not by inspection. The reviewer substituted the wrong operator into the source - .AND.->.EQV., .EQV.->.AND., .OR.->.NEQV. - and all three tests STILL PASSED under both gfortran and the frozen LFortran. A test that passes with the wrong operator substituted establishes nothing about that operator.
findings.why_the_mutation_campaign_missed_it: The author's 114-mutation campaign corrupted ORACLES, INPUTS and OMISSIONS, all of which a wrong-operator implementation survives. Only mutating the OPERATOR UNDER TEST can detect this vacuity class. This is the durable lesson of the finding.
findings.closure: Closed in 67d2d26. Every binary logical fixture now asserts the FULL truth table: .AND. TT->T, TF->F, FT->F, FF->F; .OR. TT->T, TF->T, FT->T, FF->F; .EQV. TT->T, TF->F, FT->F, FF->T; .NEQV. TT->F, TF->T, FT->T, FF->F. Each row set is inconsistent with all three alternative operators.
findings.reviewer_verification: The reviewer re-ran ALL 12 operator substitutions rather than the requested minimum sample: 24/24 compiler runs FAILED as required across both toolchains, including the three swaps that originally passed.
findings.permanent_remedy: The 12 operator substitutions are now a PERMANENT part of the generator via its operator_mutations table; generator --check reports '12 operator'. This prevents recurrence rather than fixing one instance.

findings.issue: The unary table was asserted on a single row (.NOT. .FALSE. only), which cannot establish a unary operator.
findings.closure: Closed in 67d2d26; .NOT. now asserts both F->T and T->F, both as counted observations with omission guards.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION, not by inspection - and the mutation must target the FEATURE UNDER TEST, not merely its oracle.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.final_campaign: 13 parents pass per compiler; 142/142 mutations fail per compiler: 55 oracle, 25 input, 49 omission, 12 OPERATOR-SUBSTITUTION, plus 1 reverse sentinel mutation weakening -19 to 19.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reviewer_reran: All 12 operator substitutions, 24/24 failing across both toolchains.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.new_precedent_established: For any packet testing an OPERATOR or a CLASSIFICATION, the mutation campaign MUST include substituting every plausible alternative operator. An oracle/input/omission sweep is provably insufficient.

what_the_fixtures_actually_observe.gap_acknowledged: Classification is a STATIC, source-level property. A running program cannot print that an operation was classified as numeric. Every fixture here observes a runtime CONSEQUENCE - an integer value, a character LEN/KIND/value, or a logical branch result - not the classification label itself.
what_the_fixtures_actually_observe.reviewer_judgement: The recorded catalogue limitation text stating this gap was examined specifically and judged SPECIFIC AND HONEST, not boilerplate.
what_the_fixtures_actually_observe.strongest_oracle: numeric-divide-op: 17/5=3 genuinely discriminates integer truncation from real division, and would fail under a real-division implementation returning 3.4.
what_the_fixtures_actually_observe.weakest_oracle: unary-plus-integer: unary plus is near-identity, so +(-19)=-19 supports value preservation only. Retained with its limitation recorded rather than overclaimed.

restriction_and_kind_analysis.p6_finding: 10.1.5.1 p6 contains only ONE explicit shall - that kind type parameters shall be the same for character relational operands. All other S006 material is definitional or admissive and therefore cannot support a diagnostic expectation.
restriction_and_kind_analysis.principle_applied: A facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if the unit it is filed under actually prohibits something, a processor is REQUIRED to reject, and a single-image program can portably observe it. A unit that defines or classifies CANNOT support a negative.
restriction_and_kind_analysis.character_kind_match_deferred: character-kind-match-restriction left pending because portable distinct character kinds are not guaranteed to exist; kinds are processor dependent and assuming a non-default kind is a known error.
restriction_and_kind_analysis.reviewer_audited_both_directions: The reviewer checked both for wrongly retained diagnostics and for wrongly deferred ones, and found NO required diagnostic had been wrongly deferred.
restriction_and_kind_analysis.kind_assertion: Only the CHARACTER result kind is asserted, justified by same-kind default character operands and Table 10.2. No numeric, logical or relational result kind is asserted, respecting the 10.1.9.3 p4 precedent that for equal-range integer, equal-precision real or different-kind logical operands only one of the operand kinds is required.
restriction_and_kind_analysis.reviewer_verdict: Character result-kind assertion confirmed safe for same-kind default operands.
